title: Folder
summary: A bare organizational container with no behavior — the 'plain box' for grouping anything: remotes, effects, config objects, workspace clutter.

details.heading: No extras
details.body: Folder adds nothing beyond Instance basics (Name, Parent, children). No physics, no rendering, no special events — that's the point.

explanation.whatItIs: A drawer label. It exists purely to hold other things together under one name.
explanation.whyItExists: Hierarchy hygiene: 'Remotes', 'Effects', 'Zombies' — named groups keep the Explorer sane and lookups short.
whenToUse: Holding leaderstats (a Folder named 'leaderstats' on the Player is the leaderboard convention)
whenNotToUse: When you need model-like behavior (pivot, bounding box) — use Model
For GUI layout — Frames are the GUI containers
tips: The leaderstats convention is literally just a Folder — name it exactly 'leaderstats'
Folders replicate like anything else — great for organizing ReplicatedStorage
commonMistakes: Confusing Folder with Model when you actually need physics grouping
Deep folder nesting making paths brittle — balance organization with path length

examples.title: Effects container pattern
examples.code:
local effects = Instance.new("Folder")
effects.Name = "Effects"
effects.Parent = workspace

local function spawnExplosion(position)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Position = position
    part.Parent = effects   -- all effects live in one tidy place
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(part, 2)
end
